name: llm_lane_repairs_lq1010_20261108
comment: ANCHOR: llm_lane_repairs_lq1010_20261108 — review 999 found that 3c216df08 (LQ-978) fixed 1 of the
4 LLM lanes Fable Q5 named. This is the remaining package, and each item is proved here:
(1) keepalive quota burn — a */30 cron spent a real generate on each free OAuth lane every run
(~2,597 in 30 days) and graded a 429 as a dead lane (54 failed runs, exit 1, while /health said
authenticated=true). The ping now runs only when the token needs a roll (a stated expiry inside
2 h, or 6 h idle => 4/day), carries _skip_consumption=True, and a 429 is ok_rate_limited: no alert,
no regression, exit 0, with quota_exhausted + rate_limited_until recorded so the ticks inside the
900 s window skip the ping.
(2) adjudicator provider mismatch — the gateway walked the whole provider order, so
contradiction_adjudicator (allowed_lanes [fast, deepseek-flash]) was served by grok 129 times in
14 d. allowed_lanes now binds the plan (enabled_providers), the _anthropic_route exemption covers
only anthropic, and configured_plan marks anthropic no_transport for a process that is not
anthropic_first. The adjudicator also stops hand-parsing: lib.llm_json_contract.recover_json_object
(strict -> fenced -> embedded) plus the contradiction_verdict.v1 schema, with ONE retry on a
different allowed lane before the UNRESOLVED row is written.
(3) curator serial calls — one lane call per 5 articles and per transcript. Now: deterministic
pre-filter (nothing to judge, non-English), 20-row batches, and a run-wide wall budget
(TOPIC_CURATOR_LLM_BUDGET_S, default 900) that stops the step and leaves unreached rows pending.
(4) iris timeout — the Sunday gap-recommendation site passed 20 s, below the lane's own successful
tail (grok p95 29.3 s, max ok 29.5 s), and the answer was swallowed into '(LLM unavailable)'.
iris now adopts the LQ-865 resolver (timeout=None) and config/llm_lane_budgets.json sizes
iris_taxonomy_agent at 40 s from the measured tail; an AST check fails any new literal.
Hermetic: fake connections, fake lanes, fake probes, tmp state roots. No DB, no network, no LLM call.
